proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ t i
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  obtain ⟨j, k, hij, hik, hjk⟩ : ∃ j k : Fin 3, i ≠ j ∧ i ≠ k ∧ j ≠ k := by decide +revert
  have h1 := t.oangle_incenter_eq hij hik hjk
  have h2 := t.oangle_excenter_singleton_eq hij hik hjk
  have hI : t.incenter ≠ t.points i := t.incenter_ne_point i
  have hE : t.excenter {i} ≠ t.points i := (t.excenterExists_singleton i).excenter_ne_point i
  have hj : t.points j ≠ t.points i := fun h => hij (t.independent.injective h).symm
  have hk : t.points k ≠ t.points i := fun h => hik (t.independent.injective h).symm
  have add1 := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add hj hI hk
  have add2 := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add hj hE hk
  rw [← h1] at add1
  rw [← h2] at add2
  have h2z : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle t.incenter (t.points i) (t.excenter {i}) = 0 := by
    have add3 := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add hj hI hE
    have e : (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points j) (t.points i) t.incenter = (2 : ℤ) • EuclideanGeometry.oangle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.excenter {i}) := by
      rw [two_zsmul, two_zsmul, add1, add2]
    rw [← add3, smul_add] at e
    exact left_eq_add.mp e
  have hc := (EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_zero_or_eq_pi_iff_collinear (p₁ := t.incenter) (p₂ := t.points i) (p₃ := t.excenter {i})).mp (Real.Angle.two_zsmul_eq_zero_iff.mp h2z)
  rwa [Set.insert_comm] at hc
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i : Fin 3), Collinear ℝ ({t.points i, t.incenter, t.excenter {i}} : Set P)
